clarification.bootstrap_routing: Routing bootstrap metrics remain case-level. Each replicate computes per-domain case accuracy, averages equally over seeds within domain, then averages domains equally for macro accuracy.
clarification.cross_seed_domain_aggregation: After each seed/domain segmentation metric is obtained from its aggregate pixel confusion matrix, seeds are averaged equally within each domain. Three-domain and historical-domain summaries then average domains equally.
clarification.domain_drop_checks: The D1 and D3 no-domain-drop conditions are checked on every unrounded seed/domain metric, as already registered.
clarification.forgetting: For each seed and historical domain, forgetting is fixed Oracle-snapshot foreground Dice minus Shared-final foreground Dice; Drishti_GS is current-domain performance and is not included in the historical forgetting average.
clarification.routing: Routing observations are cases. Per-seed/domain accuracy is correct validation cases divided by validation cases; macro accuracy is the equal-domain mean after equal-seed aggregation.
clarification.segmentation: The exact frozen regenerated-B0 evaluator has precedence: for each seed/domain/expert or policy, accumulate the 3x3 pixel confusion matrix over all authorized validation cases, ignore label 255, then derive per-class Dice/IoU, Mean Dice, Foreground Dice, and Mean IoU. Do not average case-level Dice or IoU.
